source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
2. Record the date and time of the inspection.
3. Detail the specific location and property address of the building being inspected.
4. List reasons for the inspection (e.g., scheduled audit, complaint, post-construction check).
5. Provide credentials of the inspector(s) involved, including name, qualification, certification, and affiliation.
6. Methodically document each accessibility feature that was inspected, such as:
   a. Building entrances (number and condition)
   b. Parking lot (availability of designated accessible parking spaces)
   c. Pathways (surface quality, slope, width)
   d. Doors (width, type, opening mechanism, threshold height)
   e. Ramps (slope, width, handrails, landings)
   f. Elevators (presence, size, controls at accessible height)
   g. Stairs (handrails, tread size, nosing)
   h. Restrooms (designated and accessible, grab
